indicator.definition: Producto interior bruto a precios corrientes por habitante, expresado en estándar de poder adquisitivo PPS UE-27 desde 2020.
indicator.label: PIB por habitante en estándar de poder adquisitivo
indicator.source_label: Gross domestic product (GDP) at current market prices by NUTS 3 region
indicator.unit_label: Purchasing power standard (PPS, EU27 from 2020), per inhabitant

limitations: GDP per inhabitant in PPS is economic context, not a complete measure of welfare, distribution, service quality, integrity, or democratic accountability.
This is one real Eurostat family selected by an explicit Spain/unit rule; the four acquired datasets are not a representative outcome codebook.
Only one verified source release is available here, so every observation is baseline; no real revision, deletion, or correction is claimed yet.
Eurostat status codes are retained exactly. Breaks, provisional values, estimates, confidentiality, changing NUTS boundaries, and methodology must be considered before comparison.
No political action is credited or blamed and no causal effect is inferred.
